comments.author: Wystein
comments.body: As long as we are on the subject of quests - some quests like this one are marked with a red star in the database. Does anybody know what that means?

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body: It means the quest information has been translated to English (hovering over the star says 'English'). However, I think quests are marked with the red star even if someone has edited the quest information at least once (doesn't matter what they do). For example for this quest, I assume that Curious clicked on the Edit/Update button, without putting text in.
